features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.desc: You copy Transmutation spells in half the time and for half the gold.

features.name: Minor Alchemy
features.desc: Over 10 minutes, you transform one nonmagical material into another (wood to stone and the like).

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.desc: You create a stone that grants its bearer one benefit (Darkvision, +10 feet of Speed, proficiency in Con saving throws, or Resistance to an elemental damage type).

features.name: Shapechanger
features.desc: You can cast Polymorph on yourself at will (into a beast of CR 1 or lower) without a spell slot.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.desc: You expend your Transmuter's Stone for a powerful effect: removing effects, restoring youth, or a major transformation.
